title:
Comment of Beth Goldstein in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 10/17/2026

documents.name: 151626.txt
documents.text:
Beth Goldstein, ANCHORAGE, AK.
No data center. We pay enough high energy costs in Alaska. We do not need or want a data center gobbling 
Up our water and our electricity. We are on the verge of running out of ways to heat our homes and keep our
Lights on we don’t need a data center taxing our system even more. I fully oppose these data centers and the lack of regulation of AI as well.
